group: Round 6 · Loot: item icons and pickup kit (loaded by the game)
title: Item icons: magic items
use: Icons for the 23 magic items of loot.js (master_bolt to stymphalian_feathers) and the 5 new ones of loot-design.md (ares_shield, lotus_card, cerberus_ball, dionysus_vine, hermes_vitamins).
prompt: A sheet of 28 game item icons in a grid of 7 columns by 4 rows, one item per 256-pixel cell, read left to right and top to bottom in exactly this order: 1. Spark of the Master Bolt, a short javelin of crackling white-gold lightning; 2. Hephaestus's Golden Net, a folded net of fine golden chain; 3. Medusa's Head (in a bag), a lumpy sack with snakes poking out of the top; 4. Nemesis's Fortune Coin, a bronze coin with a different face on each side; 5. Aegis Charm, a small round shield charm with a gorgon face; 6. Pegasus Whistle, a silver whistle shaped like a winged horse; 7. Nectar Flask, a small glass flask of glowing golden nectar; 8. Bag of Winds, a leather bag tied shut, gusts swirling out; 9. Shadow of the Helm, a dark bronze helm trailing black smoke; 10. Winged Sneakers, a pair of sneakers with small white wings; 11. Jar of Greek Fire, a clay jar with green fire licking from the neck; 12. Thunder of Zeus, a gold lightning-bolt charm; 13. Lyre of Orpheus, a small golden lyre with floating music notes; 14. Golden Apple of Discord, a shining golden apple; 15. Athena's Owl, a little grey owl with big eyes; 16. Ariadne's Thread, a ball of glowing golden thread; 17. Caduceus of Hermes, a winged staff with two twined snakes; 18. Erymanthian Boar Tusk, a huge curved boar tusk; 19. Trident of the Sea, a small sea-green trident charm with water drops; 20. Ray of the Sun Chariot, a golden sun disc with rays; 21. Hourglass of Kronos, a dark gold hourglass with glowing sand; 22. Cornucopia, a horn overflowing with fruit and gold coins; 23. Stymphalian Feathers, a fan of three sharp bronze feathers; 24. Shield of Ares, a round red-and-bronze shield with a boar's head; 25. Lotus Casino Card, a glowing green-and-gold casino key card with a lotus; 26. Cerberus's Red Ball, a big red rubber ball with three bite marks; 27. Dionysus's Grapevine, a curling purple grapevine with leaves and grapes; 28. Hermes's Multivitamins, a small bottle of vitamins with a winged cap. Inventory icons in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: each item a small chunky 3D voxel model seen from a high three-quarter angle, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading and a small highlight, a bold silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels, celestial bronze that glows faintly, magic parts with a soft glow. Each icon is centred in its own square cell with even padding and never touches its neighbours; no frame, border, rarity colour, number or label in the cells (the game adds those). The whole sheet sits on a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, texture or cast shadow, so the background can be removed. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
